summary.en: The storyboard link: swatches, glyphs or the line itself grow into six 16:9 panels, sketches draw in them, panel 3 (the merge's first frame) is outlined in the line colour; the stage name. Opening the film, the line is cut into four segments that open into panels.
summary.zh: 分镜环节：色板、字形或那条线本身长成六格 16:9 分镜，格里画出草图，第三格（合并镜头的第一帧）用线色描边选中；中央是阶段名。作为片子第一环时，那条线切成四段打开成分镜。

fits: A reel's planning step; the first link of the short chain.
notFor: More than six panels; boards whose panels show nothing the film does.

intent.en: Show the film planned before anything moves, and choose the shot the camera will go into.
intent.zh: 在一切动起来之前先展示规划好的片子，并选出镜头要推进去的那一格。

content.en: No copy of its own: the stage name and note.
content.zh: 本身没有文案：阶段名和注释。

fits.zh: 作品集里的规划一步；短链的第一环。

notFor.zh: 超过六格；格里画的不是片子真做的事。

en: Pass the film's chain as `before` / `after`: the hand-offs read the neighbours, and the link's length is fitted with them (a link alone fits differently).
zh: 把整片的链作为 before / after 传进来：交接读的是相邻环节，长度也和它们一起拟合（单独一环拟合出的长度不同）。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
